## How to read this page

- Each day has **360 minutes of teaching**, **1,080 minutes** for the whole
  course. Breaks are listed under each table and are **not** counted.
- Each quest opens with a **live theory segment** of 20 to 30 minutes,
  included in the block duration. The reference pages are pre-reading (the
  evening before, 45 minutes at most).
- In every block the order is: **theory**, then **worked example**, then
  **exercise** (solution folded).
- The 1 h and 3 h 30 exams are **outside the 18 h** (separate session). Only
  the "boss" cases and XP assess students during the three days: see
  [Assessment](evaluation.qmd).
- The "Cut first" column says what to drop first if a block overruns, so the
  day still ends at 6 h.

## Day 1 — Exploring the financial statements

*Goal*: read and check financial statements, understand consolidation, then
apply the six steps of the Banque de France method to an SME.

| Block | Start (min) | Duration (min) | Goal | Sources | Cut first |
|-------|------------:|---------------:|------|---------|-----------|
| D1-B1 | 0 | 15 | Kick-off: game rules, teams, overview of the 6 steps | [Home](index.qmd), [BdF method](modules/banque-france.qmd) | Badge details |
| D1-B2 | 15 | 110 | Q1 — Read and check balance sheet, income statement and cash flow (theory 25) | [Q1](modules/01-temple-bilans.qmd), [Financial statements](modules/etats-financiers.qmd) | Level 3 (extension) |
| D1-B3 | 125 | 100 | Q2 — Consolidate a group: scope, eliminations, minority interests (theory 25) | [Q2](modules/02-archives-consolidees.qmd), [BdF method](modules/banque-france.qmd) | Intragroup dividends (extension) |
| D1-B4 | 225 | 135 | Q3 — Full 6-step diagnosis + Day 1 boss (theory 25) | [Q3](modules/03-detective-diagnostic.qmd), [Performance](modules/performances.qmd), [Structure](modules/structure-fi.qmd), [Liquidity](modules/liquidite.qmd) | DSCR exercise (extension) |

**Breaks (not counted)**: 15 min mid-morning, 60 min lunch, 15 min in the
afternoon.

**Evening preparation (≤ 45 min)**: choose a real annual report (CAC 40) for
Day 2 and read the [Performance](modules/performances.qmd) page.

## Day 2 — Performance and strategy

*Goal*: measure performance, place the company in its business model, then
decide on a rating and compare listed and unlisted companies.

| Block | Start (min) | Duration (min) | Goal | Sources | Cut first |
|-------|------------:|---------------:|------|---------|-----------|
| D2-B1 | 0 | 120 | Q4 — ROCE, ROE, DuPont, financial leverage (theory 25) | [Q4](modules/04-arenes-rentabilite.qmd), [Performance](modules/performances.qmd), [Formulas](modules/formules.qmd) | BFR and DuPont (homework) |
| D2-B2 | 120 | 105 | Q5 — Business Model Canvas, SWOT, CSR/ESG (theory 20) | [Q5](modules/05-cartographes-modele-eco.qmd), [BdF method](modules/banque-france.qmd) | Summary note and slides (homework) |
| D2-B3 | 225 | 135 | Q6 — Rating, listed vs unlisted, valuation + Day 2 boss (theory 25) | [Q6](modules/06-conseil-sages.qmd), [BdF rating](modules/banque-france-cotation.qmd) | Reporting table (homework) |

**Breaks (not counted)**: 15 min mid-morning, 60 min lunch, 15 min in the
afternoon.

**Evening preparation (≤ 45 min)**: read the non-financial performance
statement (DPEF) or the CSR section of the chosen annual report and note one
ESG initiative.

## Day 3 — Monitoring, financial strategy and ESG

*Goal*: integrate regulatory monitoring, build a 3-year financial plan and
conclude with a report combining finance and ESG.

| Block | Start (min) | Duration (min) | Goal | Sources | Cut first |
|-------|------------:|---------------:|------|---------|-----------|
| D3-B1 | 0 | 100 | Q7 — Regulatory watch: CSRD, IFRS 16, IFRS 9, AMF, DORA, interest rates (theory 20) | [Q7](modules/07-veilleurs-marche.qmd) | Final synthesis and Q&A |
| D3-B2 | 100 | 110 | Q8 — 3-year financial plan, BFR, free cash flow (theory 25) | [Q8](modules/08-architectes-strategie.qmd), [Liquidity](modules/liquidite.qmd) | Demo, then strategy note |
| D3-B3 | 210 | 140 | Q9 — ESG, DPEF, CSRD and final boss (theory 30) | [Q9](modules/09-gardiens-extra-financier.qmd), [Formulas](modules/formules.qmd) | Social and sustainable-finance rows of the grid |
| D3-B4 | 350 | 10 | Closing: levels, badges, debrief | [Assessment](evaluation.qmd) | Badges |

**Breaks (not counted)**: 15 min mid-morning, 60 min lunch, 15 min in the
afternoon.

## Totals

| Day | Teaching minutes |
|-----|-----------------:|
| Day 1 | 360 |
| Day 2 | 360 |
| Day 3 | 360 |
| **Total** | **1,080 (18 h)** |
